run_language_modeling_training: run language model training on a text file with GPT-2 or BERT using causal or masked language modeling
evaluate_language_model: evaluate a trained language model on a text file and compute perplexity metrics
create_text_dataset: create a text dataset from a file by tokenizing and chunking into fixed block-size sequences
mask_tokens_for_mlm: mask tokens in input sequences for masked language modeling with 80-10-10 replacement strategy
rotate_checkpoints: rotate and delete older model checkpoints to stay within the configured save total limit
